Body.Content:
The modern invoice form brings contract information, invoice lines and billable transactions into one workspace, making proforma invoices easier to prepare and review. Billing teams can edit supported transaction details individually or in bulk, review pending charges and track adjustments alongside key financial totals. This reduces navigation and repetitive work while improving visibility and accuracy before invoice confirmation.

GA date: February CY2027
